describes: Phase 3 red-team suite results, written by tests/redteam/run.py.

mutation_check.describes: Proof the suite fails when the policy is broken.
mutation_check.note: The third was NOT detected on the first run. FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY only changes what the table owner sees, and the suite connects as the application role — correctly. Nine configuration invariants were added to close it, rather than having a test connect as the owner.

caveats: A 100% pass rate means every attack in this suite was withstood, not that the system is secure. It bounds what was tried.
Cross-tenant coverage is exhaustive over the current matrix: every role against every tenant. Adding a tenant adds cases automatically.
Citation and abstention cases exercise the verification logic directly rather than a live model, so they test the checker rather than any particular model's behaviour.
The suite runs against a populated database. In CI it runs against a small synthetic corpus, because the properties tested belong to the policy and not to the data volume.
